Last updated: October 2026
1. Introduction
This Cookie Policy explains how ETÉRA (“we”, “us”, or “our”) uses cookies and similar technologies on https://www.eteracreative.com (the “Website”).
It describes what cookies are, the purposes for which they may be used, and how visitors can manage their preferences.
This Cookie Policy should be read together with our Privacy Policy and Website Terms of Use.
2. What Are Cookies?
Cookies are small text files that websites may store on your computer, smartphone, tablet, or other device when you visit them.
They help websites operate correctly, remember certain preferences, and, where applicable, collect information about how visitors interact with website content.
Similar technologies, such as local storage and tracking pixels, may perform related functions.
Some cookies are placed directly by the Website, while others may be placed by third-party services integrated into it.
3. Categories of Cookies
Depending on the technical configuration of the Website, the following categories of cookies and similar technologies may be used.
3.1. Strictly Necessary Cookies
These cookies are required for the proper operation, security, and essential functionality of the Website.
They may support functions such as:
Maintaining technical website sessions;
Protecting the Website against security threats;
Remembering cookie consent preferences;
Supporting essential website functionality.
Strictly necessary cookies do not require prior consent where they meet the applicable legal conditions.
3.2. Analytics and Performance Cookies
Where implemented, analytics cookies may help us understand how visitors interact with the Website.
They may collect information relating to:
Page visits and navigation patterns;
Website traffic and performance;
Interaction with Website content;
General device and browser characteristics.
This information may help us evaluate Website performance and improve its content, usability, and overall visitor experience.
Analytics cookies requiring consent will only be activated after the visitor has provided the necessary consent.
3.3. Functional Cookies
Where implemented, functional cookies may allow the Website to remember selected preferences or provide optional enhanced functionality.
Depending on their purpose and technical necessity, such cookies may require prior consent.
3.4. Marketing and Advertising Cookies

If ETÉRA implements marketing or advertising technologies, cookies or similar technologies may be used to measure campaign performance, understand advertising interactions, or support advertising activities.
Such technologies may be provided by third-party advertising platforms.
Where consent is required, marketing and advertising cookies will not be activated unless the visitor has provided the relevant consent.
4. First-Party and Third-Party Cookies
First-party cookies are set by the Website or its operating domain.
Third-party cookies may be set by external services integrated into the Website, such as analytics providers, embedded content services, or advertising platforms.
Third-party service providers may process information in accordance with their respective privacy policies and applicable legal requirements.
ETÉRA will provide information about the relevant providers and technologies used on the Website in its cookie information or preference management interface, where applicable.
5. Cookies Used on the Website
The specific cookies and similar technologies used on the Website depend on its final technical configuration and enabled services.
Where cookies are used, the relevant information should identify:
The cookie or technology name;
The provider;
Its purpose;
Its category;
Its duration or expiry period;
Whether consent is required.
The Website's cookie information and preference management interface should reflect the technologies actually deployed and be updated when these technologies change.
6. Cookie Consent and Preferences
Where legally required, the Website will request your consent before placing or accessing non-essential cookies or activating equivalent tracking technologies.
Visitors should be able to:
Accept optional cookies;
Reject non-essential cookies;
Choose between available optional categories;
Change or withdraw their consent at any time.
Refusing optional cookies will not prevent access to the main informational content of the Website.
Strictly necessary cookies may remain active where their use is permitted without consent under applicable law.
Consent preferences should be managed through the cookie settings mechanism provided on the Website.
7. Managing Cookies Through Your Browser
Most web browsers allow users to manage cookies through their settings.
Depending on the browser, you may be able to:
View stored cookies;
Delete existing cookies;
Block certain categories of cookies;
Restrict third-party cookies;
Configure cookie-related privacy preferences.
Please note that blocking or deleting strictly necessary cookies may affect the proper functioning of certain Website features.
Browser settings do not necessarily replace the consent choices required for optional tracking technologies used by the Website.
8. Processing of Personal Data
Certain cookies and similar technologies may involve the processing of personal data, including online identifiers or information relating to Website usage.
Where such processing occurs, it is carried out in accordance with the GDPR and applicable data protection legislation.
Further information about personal data processing, legal bases, retention, third-party recipients, international transfers, and your rights is available in our Privacy Policy.
9. Changes to This Cookie Policy
ETÉRA may update this Cookie Policy to reflect changes in Website functionality, cookie technologies, third-party services, or applicable legal requirements.
The latest version will be made available on the Website, together with its revision date.
Where required, visitors will be asked to provide new consent before relevant additional tracking activities are activated.
10. Contact
